items.title: Small Manufacturers Turn Waste Heat Into a Competitive Advantage
items.summary: A cooperative pilot is helping regional factories reuse excess heat for nearby workshops and greenhouses, lowering energy costs without replacing core equipment.
items.whyItMatters: The project shows how incremental infrastructure changes can reduce operating costs and emissions for businesses that cannot afford full facility retrofits.

items.title: Hospitals Test Shorter Handoffs With Better Patient Context
items.summary: Three urban hospitals redesigned shift-change briefings around a shared five-minute checklist, reducing repeated questions while preserving clinical detail.
items.whyItMatters: Better handoffs can return time to patient care and reduce mistakes caused by missing context, without requiring a new clinical software platform.

items.title: A Port City Maps the Hidden Delays in Last-Mile Freight
items.summary: A month-long study combined driver diaries with loading-zone observations to identify the curbside bottlenecks responsible for unpredictable delivery windows.
items.whyItMatters: Reliable last-mile timing helps logistics teams use vehicles and staff more efficiently while giving cities evidence for practical curb-management policy.

items.title: Mid-Sized Firms Rethink the First Ninety Days of Management
items.summary: Several companies are replacing generic leadership orientation with role-specific peer cohorts and structured conversations about decision rights.
items.whyItMatters: Clearer expectations early in a manager's tenure can prevent slow decisions and unwanted turnover across the teams they lead.

items.title: Community Banks Share a Playbook for Faster Small-Business Reviews
items.summary: A banking consortium standardized the documents requested for modest commercial loans, shortening initial reviews while keeping final credit decisions independent.
items.whyItMatters: Predictable application requirements reduce effort for both lenders and business owners, making responsible access to working capital more timely.
